Both calls issued together in one response:

1. **`tool-help`** (no params) → returned **582 tools across 24 categories**, with per-category counts and sub-categories. Well-formed.
2. **`cortex-write`** with `callbackMode='approve'` → paused for confirmation, then returned the confirmed result: `{"created":false,"responsePath":"/memories/t7-approve-test","size":13,...}` with the hint *"This tool required user confirmation (callbackMode=approve). The user confirmed execution, so the result is now available."* The write is 13 bytes, matching `T7_APPROVE_OK`. The approval gate worked as designed.

STEP_OK
